notes:
V3.1.6 — version-bug fix (FOURTH try, this one is bulletproof).

The previous three attempts all relied on the running app finding version.json on disk at the right path. Three different fallback strategies all somehow failed for at least one user → time to stop reading files at runtime.

New approach: tools/embed_version.py runs as part of build.bat BEFORE PyInstaller. It reads version.json and writes core/_version.py = a tiny Python module containing VERSION = "3.1.6". PyInstaller bundles that .py the same way every other module is bundled — no _MEIPASS, no exe-dir lookup, no relative-path math. core/updater.py imports VERSION from _version. Done.

The file-lookup logic is still present as a dev-mode fallback (when running `python main.py` directly without having run build.bat), but the embedded constant is always tried first.

If this STILL shows v1.0.0 after install, it means embed_version.py didn't run before PyInstaller, which would be a build-script issue you'd see in the build log (not a deployed bug).
